page: Google Cloud Platform n4d-standard-4 is a general-purpose virtual machine offering 4 vCPUs mapped across 2 physical AMD EPYC 9B45 cores via simultaneous multithreading on the x86_64 architecture. The instance includes 16 GB of memory, yielding a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4 GB per virtual core. Cache architecture features 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache. It incorporates vector instruction extensions including AVX-512 (supporting VNNI and BF16 formats) and hardware-accelerated cryptographic primitives like AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The instance contains no bundled local storage and has no hardware GPUs attached.

Benchmark results show strong single-core compute performance, placing in the top decile for single-threaded stress-ng metrics (3452.38), Geekbench single-core processing (2519.0), single-threaded gzip compression (37.44 GB/s), and single-threaded bzip3 decompression (16.43 GB/s). Multi-core processing aligns with expectations for a 4-vCPU footprint, recording an average-tier PassMark CPU score of 9114.6 and Geekbench multi-core score of 5733.0. In cached environments, small-block memory read bandwidth achieves 418.9 GB/s. However, uncached 256 MB memory throughput drops significantly to 37.73 GB/s read and 25.86 GB/s write, falling into lower benchmark percentiles.

The qualitative cost-performance balance favors workloads that rely heavily on per-thread instruction throughput rather than large sustained multi-core scaling or extreme unbuffered memory throughput. The lack of integrated local storage means persistence requires remote block storage, impacting storage-intensive configurations. Workloads running within the 16 GB memory envelope benefit from modern CPU instruction sets without the overhead of higher vCPU tier allocations.

Google Cloud Platform n4d-standard-4 is well structured for standard application workloads including web serving (demonstrating 14.39 GB/s throughput in static web serving benchmarks), in-memory caching like Redis (achieving 7.58 million SET operations per second), intermediate compilation tasks, microservices, and modest relational database systems.
description: Google Cloud Platform n4d-standard-4 is a general-purpose instance featuring 4 vCPUs derived from 2 dedicated AMD EPYC 9B45 physical cores and 16 GB of system RAM. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture with AVX-512 and cryptographic hardware extensions, the system delivers upper-tier single-core CPU throughput, as reflected by strong Geekbench single-core and single-threaded compression benchmarks. Multi-core capacity and system memory scores remain within median expectations, while sustained uncached memory bandwidth demonstrates modest throughput. The instance includes no attached local storage and operates without GPU acceleration. Balancing compute density with memory capacity in a balanced 1:4 allocation, n4d-standard-4 is suited for mid-tier application hosting, Redis caches, static web serving, and continuous integration pipelines.
